"""在公开媒体与独立档案边界核对本组成果，不锁定SVG内部实现。"""
import hashlib,json,math,pathlib,subprocess,sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
manifest=json.loads((root/'manifest.json').read_text())
for f in manifest['files']:
    p=root/f['path']
    assert p.is_file(),str(p)
    assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['sha256'],str(p)
expected={
'FH13':'不过，并不是每个坏死的股骨头都会塌陷。',
'FH14':'受损范围、位置等因素，都会影响进展。',
'FH15':'所以，坏死说的是骨组织死亡。',
'FH16':'塌陷说的是支撑结构失效后，外形发生了改变。'}
mapping=json.loads((root/'segment-mapping.json').read_text())['segments']
speech=json.loads((root/'evidence/109-actual-speech.json').read_text())
provenance=json.loads((root/'references/109-source.json').read_text())
assert (root/provenance['generationRecord']).is_file()
prompts=json.loads((root/provenance['generationPrompts']).read_text())
assert prompts['提示词']
report=[]
for name,text in expected.items():
    card=json.loads((root/'cards'/f'{name}.json').read_text())
    assert card['text']==text and card['voice']=={'speaker':'zh_female_vv_uranus_bigtts','speechRate':0}
    stable=next(x for x in mapping if x['card']==name)
    assert card['segmentId']==stable['segmentId'] and card['order']==stable['order'] and card['text']==stable['text']
    task=next(x for x in speech['tasks'] if x['id']==card['taskId'])
    actual=next(x for x in speech['audio'] if x['taskId']==card['taskId'])
    assert task['state']=='succeeded' and actual['valid'] and actual['segmentId']==card['segmentId']
    assert actual['input']==task['input']=={'text':card['text'],'voice':card['voice']}
    assert hashlib.sha256((root/card['audio']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==card['audioSha256']
    audio=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_format','-of','json',str(root/card['audio'])]))
    duration=float(audio['format']['duration'])
    for mode,sound in [('assembly',False),('review',True)]:
        media=root/'outputs'/f'{name}-{mode}.mp4'
        meta=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-count_frames','-show_streams','-show_format','-of','json',str(media)]))
        v=next(x for x in meta['streams'] if x['codec_type']=='video')
        assert (v['width'],v['height'],v['r_frame_rate'])==(1920,1080,'30/1')
        assert any(x['codec_type']=='audio' for x in meta['streams'])==sound
        assert int(v['nb_read_frames'])==card['durationInFrames']==math.ceil(duration*30)
        assert duration<=float(meta['format']['duration'])<=duration+1/30+.002
    for media in [root/'outputs'/f'{name}-assembly.mp4',root/'outputs'/f'{name}-review.mp4',root/'outputs'/f'{name}-review.webm']:
        decoded=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-xerror','-i',str(media),'-f','null','-'],capture_output=True)
        assert decoded.returncode==0 and not decoded.stderr,decoded.stderr.decode()
    report.append({'card':name,'segmentId':card['segmentId'],'audioSeconds':duration,'frames':math.ceil(duration*30)})
continuous=json.loads((root/'evidence/109-continuous-media.json').read_text())
assert abs(continuous['originalAudioTotal']-sum(x['audioSeconds'] for x in report))<.000001
for name,size in [('group109-review.mp4',(1920,1080)),('group109-review.webm',(960,540))]:
    p=root/'outputs'/name
    meta=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-count_frames','-show_streams','-show_format','-of','json',str(p)]))
    v=next(x for x in meta['streams'] if x['codec_type']=='video')
    assert (v['width'],v['height'])==size and v['r_frame_rate']=='30/1' and int(v['nb_read_frames'])==continuous['frames']
    assert any(x['codec_type']=='audio' for x in meta['streams']) and float(meta['format']['duration'])>=continuous['originalAudioTotal']
    decoded=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-xerror','-i',str(p),'-f','null','-'],capture_output=True)
    assert decoded.returncode==0 and not decoded.stderr,decoded.stderr.decode()
for name,sound in [('FH16-assembly.mp4',False),('FH16-review.mp4',True),('FH16-review.webm',True)]:
    p=root/'outputs/group109-reproduced'/name
    meta=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-count_frames','-show_streams','-show_format','-of','json',str(p)]))
    v=next(x for x in meta['streams'] if x['codec_type']=='video')
    assert v['r_frame_rate']=='30/1' and int(v['nb_read_frames'])==141
    assert (v['width'],v['height'])==((960,540) if p.suffix=='.webm' else (1920,1080))
    assert any(x['codec_type']=='audio' for x in meta['streams'])==sound
    decoded=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-xerror','-i',str(p),'-f','null','-'],capture_output=True)
    assert decoded.returncode==0 and not decoded.stderr,decoded.stderr.decode()
changedRestore=root/'outputs/group109-reproduced-FH15'
assert manifest['version']!='group109-v2' or changedRestore.exists()
if changedRestore.exists():
    for name,sound in [('FH15-assembly.mp4',False),('FH15-review.mp4',True),('FH15-review.webm',True)]:
        p=changedRestore/name
        meta=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-count_frames','-show_streams','-show_format','-of','json',str(p)]))
        v=next(x for x in meta['streams'] if x['codec_type']=='video')
        assert v['r_frame_rate']=='30/1' and int(v['nb_read_frames'])==109
        assert (v['width'],v['height'])==((960,540) if p.suffix=='.webm' else (1920,1080))
        assert any(x['codec_type']=='audio' for x in meta['streams'])==sound
        decoded=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-xerror','-i',str(p),'-f','null','-'],capture_output=True)
        assert decoded.returncode==0 and not decoded.stderr,decoded.stderr.decode()
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','scope':'本组四段精确旁白/独立档案哈希/媒体参数/原声完整覆盖/全长解码无错误','segments':report},ensure_ascii=False))

"""用单段审阅画面与原始配音独立装配本组连续预览，避免累计AAC容器尾部。"""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,math,hashlib
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
cards=[json.loads((root/'cards'/f'FH{i}.json').read_text()) for i in range(13,17)]
outputs=root/'outputs';outputs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
time=0.;segments=[];lines=[]
for card in cards:
 audio=root/card['audio'];probe=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_format','-of','json',str(audio)]));duration=float(probe['format']['duration']);assert duration==card['audioDuration']
 picture=root/'outputs'/f"{card['id']}-review.mp4"
 assert "'" not in str(picture)
 lines += [f"file '{picture}'",f'duration {duration:.9f}']
 segments.append({'id':card['id'],'segmentId':card['segmentId'],'start':round(time,9),'end':round(time+duration,9),'originalAudioSeconds':duration,'audioSha256':hashlib.sha256(audio.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'pictureSha256':hashlib.sha256(picture.read_bytes()).hexdigest()});time+=duration
listing=outputs/'group109-picture-concat.txt';listing.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
cmd=['ffmpeg','-y','-v','error','-f','concat','-safe','0','-i',str(listing)]
for card in cards:cmd+=['-i',str(root/card['audio'])]
# 音频保留全部解码样本并原速连接；只补足原MP3实测容器时长的静音尾部。
filters=[f'[{i+1}:a:0]aresample=24000,apad=whole_dur={c["audioDuration"]}[a{i}]' for i,c in enumerate(cards)]
filters+=[''.join(f'[a{i}]' for i in range(4))+'concat=n=4:v=0:a=1[a]']
cmd+=['-filter_complex',';'.join(filters),'-map','0:v:0','-map','[a]','-c:v','libx264','-preset','fast','-crf','20','-r','30','-frames:v',str(math.ceil(time*30)),'-c:a','aac','-b:a','128k','-movflags','+faststart',str(outputs/'group109-review.mp4')]
subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-y','-v','error','-i',str(outputs/'group109-review.mp4'),'-vf','scale=960:540','-c:v','libvpx','-b:v','1200k','-c:a','libvorbis',str(outputs/'group109-review.webm')],check=True)
records=[]
for p in [outputs/'group109-review.mp4',outputs/'group109-review.webm']:
 probe=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-count_frames','-show_streams','-show_format','-of','json',str(p)]));v=next(s for s in probe['streams'] if s['codec_type']=='video');assert v['r_frame_rate']=='30/1';assert int(v['nb_read_frames'])==math.ceil(time*30);assert (v['width'],v['height'])==((1920,1080) if p.suffix=='.mp4' else (960,540));assert float(probe['format']['duration'])>=time
 decode=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-xerror','-i',str(p),'-f','null','-'],capture_output=True);assert decode.returncode==0 and decode.stderr==b'';records.append({'file':str(p.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'probe':probe,'decodeReturncode':decode.returncode,'decodeStderr':decode.stderr.decode()})
(root/'evidence/109-continuous-media.json').write_text(json.dumps({'segments':segments,'originalAudioTotal':round(time,9),'frames':math.ceil(time*30),'frameTimelineSeconds':math.ceil(time*30)/30,'timingBasis':'各段原始MP3实际探测时长，独立定位画面与完整原速原声；不读取单段AAC预览容器时长作累加','command':cmd,'records':records},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')

"""在原声与审阅媒体边界核对输入、全段采样保留和连续时间定位。"""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,array,math,sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);speech=json.loads((root/'evidence/109-actual-speech.json').read_text());timing=json.loads((root/'evidence/109-continuous-media.json').read_text());records=[]
def decode(p):
 a=array.array('f');a.frombytes(subprocess.check_output(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-i',str(p),'-ac','1','-ar','24000','-f','f32le','-']));return a
def correlation(a,b):
 assert len(b)>=len(a);n=len(a);am=sum(a)/n;bm=sum(b[:n])/n
 return sum((x-am)*(y-bm) for x,y in zip(a,b))/math.sqrt(sum((x-am)**2 for x in a)*sum((y-bm)**2 for y in b[:n]))
group=decode(root/'outputs/group109-review.mp4')
for segment in timing['segments']:
 id=segment['id'];card=json.loads((root/'cards'/f'{id}.json').read_text());audio=root/card['audio'];task=next(x for x in speech['tasks'] if x['id']==card['taskId']);a=next(x for x in speech['audio'] if x['taskId']==card['taskId']);assert task['state']=='succeeded' and a['valid'] and a['segmentId']==card['segmentId'];assert a['input']==task['input']=={'text':card['text'],'voice':card['voice']};raw=hashlib.sha256(audio.read_bytes()).hexdigest();assert raw==card['audioSha256'];actual=Path('/home/forclaw/code/ClapGrid/clapgrid/media')/(card['taskId']+'.mp3');assert hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==raw
 original=decode(audio);assert len(original)<=round(card['audioDuration']*24000);single=decode(root/'outputs'/f'{id}-review.mp4');offset=round(segment['start']*24000);singleCorr=correlation(original,single);groupCorr=correlation(original,group[offset:]);assert singleCorr>.97 and groupCorr>.97
 records.append({'id':id,'segmentId':card['segmentId'],'taskId':card['taskId'],'rawMp3Sha256':raw,'rawCopyMatchesActualTask':True,'originalDecodedSamples24k':len(original),'singleReviewDecodedSamples24k':len(single),'singleFullSpanCorrelation':singleCorr,'continuousStartSeconds':segment['start'],'continuousStartSample24k':offset,'continuousFullSpanCorrelation':groupCorr,'originalCompleteSampleSpanRetained':True})
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','records':records,'groupDecodedSamples24k':len(group),'scope':'实际MP3字节、有效输入、未变速完整原声样本及连续预览正确原声时间定位；不替代人工听审/逐字ASR'},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
